_about: Corrections to the OCR of the scanned Neoplatonist texts (milestone 25), kept apart from the text, which is shown as received. Each: the text (tools/neoplatonists.py TEXTS), what the OCR prints (a whole word), what is read, and why; 'unit' limits it to one page ('<source id>:<leaf>'), otherwise it applies to every page of the text. The reader shows the corrections beside the page and a reading with them applied; the build counts how many words each changes (reports/neoplatonists.md). Add a correction here, never in the text.

corrections.ocr: χαὶ
corrections.read: καὶ
corrections.why: The OCR reads the printed κ of this type as χ (or the Latin x), and ι as l; καί is by far the commonest word of the Greek, and χαί, xai or xal is no Greek word.
